deals.title: 新用户注册立送 2000 积分
deals.title_en: New Users Get 2,000 Credits on Signup
deals.summary: 首次注册的新用户自动到账 2000 积分（有效期 3 个月）。常态化拉新福利。
deals.summary_en: First-time signups automatically receive 2,000 credits, valid for 3 months, usable for all credit-based features. Ongoing referral-growth benefit; end date per official notice.

deals.title: 付费用户经济版模型无限畅用
deals.title_en: Unlimited Economy-Model Access for Paid Users
deals.summary: 付费用户可不限次数调用经济版模型 LLM 文本推理，不消耗积分；多模态、联网搜索等附加能力仍按积分计费。长期权益。
deals.summary_en: Paid users (Personal Standard/Premium, Enterprise Standard/Dedicated) can make unlimited LLM calls on economy models without spending credits. Multimodal and web-search add-ons still consume credits. Ongoing benefit; end date per official notice.

deals.title: 公测首周每日登录送 500~2000 积分
deals.title_en: Public Beta Week 1: Daily Login Credits (500-2,000)
deals.summary: 千问办公公测首周（2026-08-03 至 08-09），个人用户每日首次登录按档位领积分：免费用户 500、个人标准版 1000、个人高级版 2000；当日有效不结转。
deals.summary_en: During the first week of the Qwen Work public beta (Aug 3-9, 2026), individual users can claim daily login credits by tier: 500 for free users, 1,000 for Standard members, 2,000 for Premium members. Credits expire the same day.

deals.title: Qoder 一周年：领最高 2800 次 Qwen3.8-Max 免费调用，错峰时段 5 折
deals.title_en: Qoder 1st Anniversary: Up to 2,800 Free Qwen3.8-Max Calls + Off-Peak 50% Off
deals.summary: 新老用户端内「用量」面板领 800 次 Qwen3.8-Max 免费调用，活动期间下单再送 2000 次（可叠加，9 月 30 日前用完）；每日 22:00–08:00（UTC+8）错峰时段 5 折自动生效。仅个人版用户。
deals.summary_en: Claim 800 free Qwen3.8-Max calls in the in-app Usage panel; orders during the campaign get 2,000 more (stackable, use by Sep 30). Off-peak hours 22:00–08:00 (UTC+8) enjoy 50% off, auto-applied. Individual plans only.
